name: fresh-service-complaints
title: Fresh Service Complaints
description: Trustpilot category feeds sorted by latest review -> fresh 1-2 star customer-service reviews for the stores that appeared. Output feeds Handle Service Reviews Intent Signal via the task webhook.

categories.title: Category URLs
categories.description: Trustpilot category pages to read, one per market. sort=latest_review is appended automatically.

feedPagesPerCategory.title: Feed pages per category
feedPagesPerCategory.description: How many pages of the latest-review feed to read per category (~10 stores per page).

lookbackDays.title: Lookback days
lookbackDays.description: Only reviews published within this many days count as fresh.

stars.title: Star ratings
stars.description: Review star ratings to keep, as integers.

topics.title: Trustpilot topics
topics.description: Trustpilot topic tags to keep, e.g. customer_service. Empty = all topics.

maxReviewsPerCompany.title: Max reviews per company
maxReviewsPerCompany.description: Cap on reviews fetched per store, so one meltdown cannot buy hundreds of rows.

reviewBatchSize.title: Review batch size
reviewBatchSize.description: Stores per child review call. The child actor caps companyDomains at 10; never raise this.

childMaxChargeUsd.title: Charge cap per child call (USD)
childMaxChargeUsd.description: maxTotalChargeUsd passed to every child actor call. The circuit breaker, not a budget.

maxDomainsPerRun.title: Max domains per run
maxDomainsPerRun.description: Hard ceiling on stores checked in one run, whatever the feeds return.
